about.title: About Concrete of Houston
text: Concrete of Houston is locally a owned and operated concrete paving company in Houston TX, The Woodlands, Spring, Conroe, Katy, Pearland, Sugarland and surrounding areas. We are a single source specialist for both residential and commercial customers as well as municipalities in all aspects of Concrete Paving Services.

One of the key differentiators of our company compared to others is the fact that we provide turnkey horizontal construction services. We provide Sitework (Cut & Fill), Lime Stabilization, Underground Utilities (Storm, Water & Sanitary) and Concrete (Foundations & Flatwork). On the larger projects, we provide dedicated Project Management.
For more information on our products and services please contact us by mail, telephone, facsimile or e-mail. We will be happy to answer any questions you may have.
